about: The false-promise corpus (S3-2, planning-report.md §8 step 2): cold plays 2–8's findings where what the page showed promised what the world did not do, each with its state, signal, act, result and the contract it broke, and the check made of that contract on every turn of the play's own lines replayed on today's engine (bun scripts/promise-fidelity.ts --corpus; scripts/promise-corpus.ts). Each case's replayed: what the replay on 20 November found (still broken, with the turn; or not seen, fixed or its moment not come to, as the play's refused lines say).

cases.contract: a row that says Talk to someone talks to them
